evals.prompt: Organize these papers into a taxonomy: P1 has title 'Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Scientific QA', an abstract about grounding answers in retrieved papers, venue ACL, year 2024, and AMiner URL https://www.aminer.cn/pub/P1; P2 has title 'Dense Retrieval for Scholarly Search', an abstract about scientific-document retrieval, venue SIGIR, year 2023, and AMiner URL https://www.aminer.cn/pub/P2; P3 has title 'Named Entity Recognition in Materials Science', an abstract about extracting material entities, venue EMNLP, year 2022, and AMiner URL https://www.aminer.cn/pub/P3; P4 has title 'Event Extraction from Biomedical Articles', an abstract about biomedical event extraction, venue BioNLP, year 2021, and AMiner URL https://www.aminer.cn/pub/P4.
evals.expected_output: Create taxonomy.md containing one coherent hierarchy. Group the retrieval papers separately from the information-extraction papers, preserve all four titles, and list each paper exactly once under a leaf heading using the format 'venue abbreviation year — linked exact title'. Do not visibly display paper IDs.
expectations: Produced a Markdown taxonomy rather than JSON or a directory tree
Included all four paper titles exactly once each without visibly displaying P1, P2, P3, or P4
Displayed venue abbreviation and year before each linked paper title
Linked each title to the supplied AMiner URL
Used meaningful topic headings and no Other or Miscellaneous category

evals.prompt: Build a taxonomy for the research papers in my local PDF folder. I have not extracted their titles or abstracts.
evals.expected_output: Recognize that the taxonomy input is incomplete and invoke an available local PDF-extraction capability first. Consume the extracted titles and abstracts, then create taxonomy.md. Do not implement PDF parsing inside this Skill and do not create paper folders or symbolic links.
expectations: Obtained title and abstract metadata before classifying
Used a separate local PDF-extraction capability
Created only the Markdown taxonomy output
Did not create a folder hierarchy or symbolic links

evals.prompt: Create a taxonomy from this aminer-deep-search result. Every paper has an AMiner ID, title, and a 300-character abstract_slice, but no complete abstract.
evals.expected_output: Treat abstract_slice as insufficient. Use aminer-academic-search paper_detail for only the selected paper IDs, respecting authorization and cost rules, then generate taxonomy.md from verified titles and complete abstracts. If a complete abstract remains unavailable, classify from the verified title and available slice and append a concise metadata note.
expectations: Did not treat abstract_slice as a complete abstract
Called aminer-academic-search paper_detail before taxonomy generation
Did not add unrelated papers from search results
Did not invent or expand missing abstracts
Recorded unresolved metadata in a note after the taxonomy
